data.narrative: Student created comprehensive integration tests for the URL shortener service, covering the highest-risk behaviors: redirect correctness, auth protection, and analytics writes. Tests verify health checks, authentication flow (register/login/logout/token invalidation), link CRUD operations, redirect behavior, search functionality, and rate limiting. The test suite is designed to run against a live API instance and uses a custom test runner for clear pass/fail reporting.
